purpose: V02 (#1284): map every shipped route to its V07-V11 owner and to the checks that exercise it. route-matrix.mjs joins this file with the routes read from the current routers and refuses: a route with no entry, an entry that names no route, a unit, guards or help-browser ref that is not a tracked file, an e2e ref that is not a tests/specs path, a route with a view and no unit, help-browser or unfunded e2e check and no manual step, a redirect with no guards check and no manual step, and a manual or note that is not a non-empty string. With --e2e <checkout> it also checks that each e2e spec exists at harnessSha and names its route (a side-panel route must also open the side panel) or says how it gets there with via.

e2e.note: They are not checked out here, so route-matrix.mjs checks only their shape; rerun the harness against the exact candidate in V13 (#1295). A check marked funded skips without a funded testnet wallet and is not coverage until that run has one.

kinds.unit: Vitest spec in this repository (npm test) that mounts the route's view or drives the logic behind it. Source-text tripwires are not listed.
kinds.guards: src/modules/navigation/router.guards.spec.ts drives the production router: it proves where the route lands (auth, network, feature flag, redirect), not that its view renders. route-matrix.mjs checks the spec pushes the route (in the side-panel block for a side-panel route).
kinds.help-browser: scripts/help-browser scenario run by the optional Help browser evidence workflow when Help, shared UI or build files change (not a required check).
kinds.e2e: Playwright spec in the external harness, run against an exact wallet SHA.
kinds.manual: Needs a device, a live provider, mainnet or funds; record the result in the V13 signoff.
kinds.harness: scripts/migration-browser harness: drives the real packaged extension in Chromium with production messaging and persistence (no state overrides).

async-validation-invalid.title: Async validation: an invalid result blocks the action

checks.test: does not mutate when the awaited form result is invalid
awaits Vuetify validation and blocks repeated clicks while pending; false never signs
a wrong PassKey counts toward the back-off like any wrong credential
57: invalid recipient shows an address validation error
63: spending password change rejects a wrong current password
five wrong passwords start a wait that refuses even the right password

async-validation-invalid.gap: Recipient address checks are synchronous and there is no ADA Handle validation, so only password and credential checks are asynchronous.

async-validation-pending.title: Async validation: pending blocks repeat actions; a stale result is discarded

checks.test: cancels before mutation if %s changes during form validation

requires a new approval after replacement and serializes repeated clicks
${cancellation} during password verification cannot sign the abandoned request @post-v27 @offline

async-validation-pending.gap: Only unit tests assert the blocked, one-flight state; the browser test covers discarding the stale result.

cancel-once.title: Cancel, close or dismiss: the pending request is answered exactly once

checks.test: does not publish a signature returned after cancellation

cancel-once.gap: Closing the side panel parks a request instead of answering it (by design: it is re-delivered when a panel reconnects); that parking, in background.ts, has no test.
